messages:
Aisha_CS: Heads-up: QBR dry run scheduled TOMORROW 10:30am PT. Need final slide owners, a 1-page exec ask for finance, and a rehearsal of the live flow. Link to deck: https://drive.google.com/example_qbr_2026 (pre-read tab). Reply with owners and any blockers by EOD.

Ben_Sales: I'll own the renewal status slide + customer sentiment bullets for Meridian and Orion. Will add renewal timeline and quoted ARR.

Sofia_G: For Meridian: renewal risk = HIGH. They've pushed back on onboarding timelines and asked for a technical stability review. I'll own the mitigation plan and the 1-page ask.

Diego_Product: Can take the product roadmap alignment slide and add the integration milestones that affect their go-live. Need a quick call with Meridian PM to confirm priorities.

Marco_Research: I'll do the usage/health charts. Adding retention cohorts and a short churn drivers note. Quick note: NPS for the account drifted -7 since last quarter.

Lena_PM: I'll prepare the exec Q&A prep doc (3 bullets per possible tough question) and put it in slide notes. Also recommend we add two backup talking points if the demo fails.

Tom_K: I'll handle the live demo + fallback. Tested the flow end-to-end. Fallback sequence (short):
```
step 1: if model timeout > 2s -> reduce max_tokens to 128
step 2: if still slow -> switch endpoint to 'dedicated-small'
step 3: notify #release-war-room and continue with recorded clip
```
Uploading the demo script to the deck now.

ebr-bot: Dry-run readiness check: missing items -> finance ask (1-pager), exec notes on slide 3, demo fallback documented in slide notes.

Aisha_CS: Action list I'm capturing (please ack):
- Ben_Sales: renewal + ARR + outreach cadence (due EOD)
- Sofia_G: mitigation plan + 1-pager for finance (due EOD)
- Marco_Research: charts + NPS delta explanation (due 5pm PT)
- Diego_Product: integration milestones & PM confirm (due EOD)
- Lena_PM: Q&A doc + backup talking points (due 9am PT tomorrow)
- Tom_K: demo script + recorded fallback clip (upload before meeting)
I'll compile everything and share updated deck v2 by 8am PT tomorrow. If anyone can't make the dry run, say so here.

Ben_Sales: Ack. Will add outreach timeline and one suggested concession for renewal.

Sofia_G: Ack. Drafting finance ask: request 3-month extension + discounted month for onboarding. Putting language in Confluence then linking.

Marco_Research: Uploaded charts and a short note on churn drivers. Left one question for Diego re: feature rollout timing.

Diego_Product: Confirmed with Meridian PM; moved integration milestone earlier by 2 weeks in the deck.

Lena_PM: Q&A doc in slide notes; added 2 canned responses for pricing pushback.

Tom_K: Demo clip uploaded. Fallback scripted and in notes. Ran a local sim — latency spike handled by switch, recorded clip plays automatically.

ebr-bot: Reminder: Deck v2 missing from folder. Dry-run will be canceled if v2 not added 1 hour before meeting.

Aisha_CS: Deck v2 uploaded and shared. I'll send the updated invite with dial-in and rehearsal tasks. See you all 10:30am PT. End.
